description:
From clay tablets to digital currency, finance has evolved across 5,000 years of civilization. Tools have changed, but the pursuit of progress remains constant.

Today, as power shifts and intelligence awakens, a new gateway is opening. Beyond Digital, from Copilot to Autopilot, the Fintelligent World is here.

Join #Huawei at #HiFS2026 to explore the future of #AgenticBanking. Learn more: https://bit.ly/4eRSdS1 #FintelligentWorld
title: The Next Evolution of Finance: Hello Fintelligent World
